title: Arc-length mask reveal
summary: Four Bézier branches rasterised at load into one RGBA8 mask (branch id in R, 16-bit arc length across G / B, centreline distance in A) read with `texelFetch`; one `u_reveal[4]` array, a `.2` stagger over a sticky `320svh` chapter, `front = arc + .12 × edge²` so the head rounds; one fullscreen triangle in raw WebGL2, damped on the shared ticker that leaves at rest; complete and still under reduced motion and static
variants: raw WebGL2, mask built on the main thread (this)
mask built in a Worker on an OffscreenCanvas
three.js ShaderMaterial on a fullscreen triangle
